verdict.rationale: Lago has a documented API reference and an OpenAPI 3.1 schema for generating clients, so the API surface is real. Subscriptions are created when a plan is assigned to a customer, and plans can be upgraded or downgraded. However, the assign-plan guide describes a dashboard click flow, and no evidence names subscription create or update API endpoints. Pause and cancel are not evidenced at all. Missing for 10: explicit subscription create/update/terminate API endpoints, any pause capability, cancellation via API, hands-on corroboration of a dashboard-free lifecycle.
